gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Other financing sources: 'Proceeds from bond issuance' General Fund 40,000,000, Special Roads 60,000,000 (Total 100,000,000); 'Lease financing' General Fund 557,054. JSON debt_proceeds 100,557,054 = 100,000,000 + 557,054. Detail has only the Special Roads cash schedule p10 'Proceeds from Series 2022 highway allocation bonds' 60,000,000 (and its 'Bond issue premium' 703,544); the General Fund cash budget schedule (p9) prints no proceeds rows (the 40,000,000 went to escrow; p9 reconciliation only). Add the General Fund statement-column rows 40,000,000 and 557,054. Proceeds rows then tie exactly: 60,000,000 + 40,000,000 + 557,054 = 100,557,054. Note: schedule_gap.py counts every other-financing line whose label contains 'bond' as debt proceeds, so it also counts the premium lines (Special Roads 'Bond issue premium' 703,544 already in detail, and General 'Premium from bond issuance' 1,840,582 added in the next entry), which the JSON statement records in other_financing (2,544,126), not debt_proceeds: the script will show schedule 103,101,180 vs 100,557,054 (difference = premiums 2,544,126 exactly).
